# UIGridLayout

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIGridLayout")`

Arranges the `UIObject` children of its parent in a grid of equal cells, for an inventory, a shop or a level select. Parent it next to the objects it arranges.

The `Position` and `Size` of a child are ignored: every cell is `CellSize`. Cells fill a line until the next one would not fit, or until `FillDirectionMaxCells` is reached, and then start a new line.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AbsoluteContentSize` | `Vector2` | — | read-only | The space the cells take after layout, in pixels. Use it to set the `CanvasSize` of a `ScrollFrame`. |
| `CellPadding` | `UDim2` | `UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)` | read/write | The horizontal and vertical gap between cells. It does not add space around the grid; use `UIPadding` for that. |
| `CellSize` | `UDim2` | `UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100)` | read/write | The size of every cell. Its scale is a fraction of the parent, so `UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.25)` gives four cells across at any window size. |
| `FillDirection` | `Enum.FillDirection` | `Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal` | read/write | Whether cells fill rows (`Horizontal`) or columns (`Vertical`). |
| `FillDirectionMaxCells` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The largest number of cells in one line. 0 means as many as fit. A line never holds more cells than fit. |
| `HorizontalAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left` | read/write | The horizontal position of the whole grid within the parent. |
| `SortOrder` | `Enum.SortOrder` | `Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder` | read/write | The order the children are arranged in. |
| `StartCorner` | `Enum.StartCorner` | `Enum.StartCorner.TopLeft` | read/write | The corner the first cell is placed in, which also sets the direction the lines run in. |
| `VerticalAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top` | read/write | The vertical position of the whole grid within the parent. |
